newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Fed may look at inflation measures - Fraser.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Fed may look at inflation measures - Fraser.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia Governor Bernie Fraser said on Thursday the U.S. Federal Reserve might be considering a "pre-emptive" strike against inflation.
Fraser said the U.S. economy had been growing strongly now for five years with inflation remaining under control at just under 3.0 percent on average over that period.
"But in more recent months, there are just a few signs that the inflationary process has picked up a little bit, not dramatically, but a little bit," Fraser told a parliamentary committee.
"And I don't know whether it's going to happen or not, but maybe the Fed is thinking about these things in the same kind of pre-emptive way that we do."
The Federal Reserve is scheduled to hold its next meeting on September 24.
